## Research and Projects

### Medical Imaging and Colorectal Polyp Detection
**Independent Research | October – November 2025**

- Developed a preprocessing and annotation workflow for colorectal endoscopy images.
- Worked with YOLOv8, deformable convolutions (DCN), and convolutional block attention modules (CBAM).
- Used data augmentation and Weighted Box Fusion to improve small-object detection.
- Built an end-to-end workflow for automated polyp detection.

### Statistical Shape Modeling of the Subtalar Joint
**Independent Research | February – July 2025**

- Studied anatomical differences using CT and weight-bearing CT images.
- Built single-domain and multi-domain statistical shape models of the subtalar joint.
- Used Mimics, 3-matic, and MATLAB for image processing, 3D reconstruction, and PCA-based shape analysis.
- Compared anatomical shapes under weight-bearing and non-weight-bearing conditions.

### AI-Based ECG Signal Classification
**Independent Research | February – May 2026**

- Developed a Python workflow for ECG signal processing and feature engineering using synthetic biomedical datasets.
- Applied Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and K-Nearest Neighbors for classification.
- Evaluated results using confusion matrices and feature importance.

### Clinical Data Mapping with CDISC Standards
**Independent Project | September – October 2023**

- Mapped raw clinical datasets into CDISC SDTM domains.
- Created ADaM datasets using SAS for statistical analysis.
- Performed data quality checks to identify mapping and derivation inconsistencies.
